title: RNA-seq and qPCR Analysis in DBY12007 Organism
summary: This cluster is centered around the DBY12007 organism, which undergoes the HAP1 process. The organism's RNA is analyzed using RNA-seq and qPCR methods, with the latter carried out on the ABI StepOnePlus system. The Tu et al. study is referenced in the development of the YMC, which has phases of High-DO and Low-DO and utilizes Dissolved oxygen. The RNA-seq method is also used in the Tu et al. study, and the GSEA gene_or_protein is used in this study as well. The purity of RNA is assessed using the NanoDrop, which measures spectrophotometric purity via A260/A230 and A260/A280 ratios.
